sql: select avg(sent_to_response_minutes) from gold.ssas_fact_preauth_line where branch_key = 6 and request_date_key between 20260801 and 20260831 and line_source != 'Payer advance'

name: BSC Cost Budget Variance, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Cost Budget Variance], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select (toFloat64(operating_expenses) - toFloat64(operating_expenses_budget)) / toFloat64(operating_expenses_budget) from bsc.vw_financial where branch_id = 6 and month_date = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC G&A Ratio, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC G&A Ratio], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select toFloat64(ga_expenses_actual) / toFloat64(net_revenue_actual) from bsc.vw_financial where branch_id = 6 and month_date = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Readmission 30d, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Readmission 30d], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select readmission_within_30days / discharges from bsc.vw_customer where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Readmission 48h Critical, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Readmission 48h Critical], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select readmitted_to_ICU_with_48hrs / icu_discharge from bsc.vw_customer where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC External Referrals, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC External Referrals], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select referrals_volume from bsc.vw_customer where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Turnover, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Turnover], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select resignations / headcount from bsc.vw_work_force where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Revenue per FTE, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Revenue per FTE], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select (select toFloat64(net_revenue_actual) from bsc.vw_financial where branch_id = 6 and month_date = '2026-08-01') / FTE from bsc.vw_work_force where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Staff to Bed, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Staff to Bed], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select FTE / (select sum(is_available) / uniqExact(date_key) from gold.ssas_fact_bed_occupancy_daily where branch_key = 6 and date_key between 20260801 and 20260831 and is_inpatient_ward = 'Yes' and is_excluded_ward = 'No') from bsc.vw_work_force where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Saudization, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Saudization], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select saudi_headcount / (headcount - pt_doctors_headcount) from bsc.vw_work_force where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Saudization takes the last closed month, branch 6, 2026 Q3 (review focus 2)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Saudization], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Quarter] = 20263))
sql: select saudi_headcount / (headcount - pt_doctors_headcount) from bsc.vw_work_force where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-09-01'

name: BSC Vacancy Rate is blank without budgeted FTE, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Vacancy Rate], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select openings / nullIf(fte, 0) from (select (select sum(number_to_hire) from gold.ssas_fact_recruiting_requisition where branch_key = 6 and approved_date_key <= 20260831 and (filled_date_key is null or filled_date_key > 20260831)) as openings, (select sum(budgeted_fte) from gold.ssas_fact_bsc_budgeted_fte where branch_key = 6 and year_date_key = 20260101) as fte)

name: BSC Time to Fill (days), branch 6, 2026-09
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Time to Fill (days)], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609))
sql: select avg(days_to_fill) from gold.ssas_fact_recruiting_requisition where branch_key = 6 and filled_date_key between 20260901 and 20260930

name: BSC Clinical to Doctor, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Clinical to Doctor], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select medical_headcount / doctors_headcount from bsc.vw_work_force where branch_id = 6 and period = '2026-08-01'

name: BSC Manual Value, PREMs, branch 6, 2026-07
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Manual Value], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "CUS_PREMS", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202607))
sql: select sum(v.numerator) / sum(v.denominator) from gold.ssas_fact_bsc_manual_value as v inner join gold.ssas_dim_bsc_kpi as k on k.bsc_kpi_key = v.bsc_kpi_key where k.kpi_code = 'CUS_PREMS' and v.branch_key = 6 and v.month_date_key = 20260701

name: BSC Manual Value, complaint rate over visits, branch 1, 2026-07
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([BSC Manual Value], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "CUS_COMPLAINT_RATE", Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202607))
sql: select (select sum(v.numerator) from gold.ssas_fact_bsc_manual_value as v inner join gold.ssas_dim_bsc_kpi as k on k.bsc_kpi_key = v.bsc_kpi_key where k.kpi_code = 'CUS_COMPLAINT_RATE' and v.branch_key = 1 and v.month_date_key = 20260701) / (select census from bsc.vw_customer where branch_id = 1 and period = '2026-07-01')
